subject.title: Feature: Private Mode for demos and content creation

question: What exact guarantee should a private session make about workspace reads, durable content writes, remote-provider transmission, retained operational metadata, and who may activate or override it?
rationale: A UI toggle cannot safely define this security boundary; the answer determines protocol shape, storage behavior, plugin and channel enforcement, provider policy, recovery semantics, and whether the product may claim “private” or “incognito.”

options.title: Full private session contract
options.body: Guarantee no private workspace or memory reads and no durable content persistence across core and participating plugins, with explicitly documented minimal metadata and provider behavior.

options.title: No-history mode only
options.body: Prevent transcript and memory persistence but keep normal workspace context and remote-provider behavior under a narrower, non-incognito name.

options.title: Do not add a guarantee
options.body: Keep existing reset, retention, context-injection, and sandbox controls separate and avoid presenting them as a private session mode.

recommendation.title: Full private session contract
recommendation.body: Guarantee no private workspace or memory reads and no durable content persistence across core and participating plugins, with explicitly documented minimal metadata and provider behavior.
